scope: ExtrudeCrv Output=SubD, natural cubic joined-piece fitting, oblique profile orientation and interactive output switching.

comparisons.topology: tagged oriented face sets; native face insertion order and component IDs excluded
comparisons.limit_mesh: every oriented density-2 limit quad by joint geometric correspondence
comparisons.sdk: Original public Surface.CreateExtrusion and SubD.CreateFromSurface output; simplified variants retained only as diagnostics

headless.native_captures: Private Xvfb/i3 through tools/rhino_oracle/run_headless.sh; private runtime directory, Wayland/compositor sockets unset; only owned Rhino closed
headless.application_tests: Unit-test application state with DISPLAY, WAYLAND_DISPLAY, WAYLAND_SOCKET, SWAYSOCK and I3SOCK removed; no GUI event loop

limits: Sampled approximation; no general continuous error certificate
Native component IDs, face insertion order and display-buffer numbering are not reproduced
